description_en: Scales out or scales down application instances in a Container Service for Kubernetes (K8s) cluster
description_zh: 扩容或下线容器服务K8s集群的应用实例
name: ScaleK8sApplication

parameters.description_en: The ID of the application. Call the [ListApplication](~~149390~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html operation to obtain the application ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The target number of application instances. The minimum value is 0.
parameters.description_zh: 需要扩容或保留的应用实例数量，最小为 0。
parameters.help_en: The target number of application instances. The minimum value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 需要扩容或保留的应用实例数量，最小为 0
parameters.name: replicas

parameters.description_en: The timeout period for the change process, in seconds.
parameters.description_zh: 变更流程超时时间，单位：秒。
